name: Kali: Flame of Samsara
source:
Navigating the intrigues of Indian high society has never been easy, but when you are forced into an engagement with your enemy – a British lord – your life is utterly upended.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Kali:_Flame_of_Samsara]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
驾驭印度上流社会的阴谋从来都不是一件容易的事，但当你被迫与你的敌人——英国领主——交战时，你的生活就被彻底颠覆了。
